data.one_liner: On‑device LLM inference for Dart/Flutter across native and web
data.what_it_does: Runs GGUF (llama.cpp) and LiteRT‑LM models locally, providing streaming chat, embeddings, multimodal input, and structured JSON output. It supports native platforms and experimental web support via WebGPU.
use_when: Need offline, no‑network LLM inference in a Flutter app
Want streaming chat or embeddings without a server
Require multimodal (audio, image) input or text‑to‑speech
Target multiple platforms (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, web)
avoid_when: Relying on GPU‑heavy models on low‑end devices
Using web exclusively where experimental support may be unstable
Need cloud‑based inference or large model hosting
strengths: Streaming API and structured JSON output
weaknesses: Complex native setup (runtime packages, build hooks)
Requires native C++ toolchain resolution on first run
Large model binaries increase app size
data.setup_notes: Add companion runtime packages (llamadart_llama_cpp_flutter, llamadart_litert_lm_flutter, etc.), run `dart run llamadart:web_setup` for web, ensure iOS/macOS deployment targets, and include runtime assets via build hook.
